name: Auto Play
description: Plays levels by itself. Reads the real obstacles, orbs and gamemode from the game, so no hitboxes are needed.

enabled.name: Auto play
enabled.description: The mod presses jump for you. Can also be switched from the pause menu.

look-ahead.name: Look-ahead (seconds)
look-ahead.description: How far ahead jumps are simulated. Higher = plans further but uses more CPU.

fly-ahead.name: Flying aim distance (seconds)
fly-ahead.description: How far ahead the ship / wave / ufo aims. Lower = reacts later but hugs tight gaps better.
